basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM Engineering Leader · AI Agents for Revenue Workflows · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Player/coach who ships AI and automation into live revenue workflows and measures the lift. Built production AI agents at LumApps that doubled outbound open rates and approved opportunities (forecast $4M/quarter in pipeline), and a GenAI demo system at Beekeeper that auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data. 13+ years partnering with Sales, Marketing, and CS to remove friction; replaced $337K in vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks. Founder of three companies, MBA-trained on translating revenue strategy into engineering work and engineering work into business outcomes.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end for revenue workflows. Built production AI agents for outbound sales and an intelligent context layer that powers strategy across product, sales, and CS.
highlights: Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day across SDR and AE teams. Forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion that is $1M in quarterly revenue.
Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Surfaces business patterns that drive strategy across product, sales, and CS.
Expanded scope to own company-wide AI transformation, governance, and sales enablement. Set the standards for how AI ships safely into live revenue workflows.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who co-owned launches with Product and Sales. Shipped AI and automation into the revenue motion: demo content, onboarding, translations, referral pipeline, all instrumented for measurable impact.
highlights: Built GenAI demo system for Sales: auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Improved demo speed and close rates.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions + OpenAI APIs) in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated since Jan 2024. Product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch guidance. 100% of customers guided through setup, time-to-first-value reduced without adding headcount.

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Employee Referral, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Advises on AI adoption, GTM engineering, and shipping pragmatic solutions that move revenue.
highlights: Mentored portfolio companies on AI strategy, technical hiring, and building GTM engineering cultures that actually ship and measure impact.
Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built every layer of the stack and shipped iteratively from blank page to 500+ live deliveries.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for autonomous systems in the real world.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research and teaching. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems.
highlights: Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time stock market analysis platform: AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals using technical and news-based data. Built for my own trading portfolio first, opened to retail traders after self-validation.
highlights: Real-time market analysis via AI agents that generate and justify trading signals. Now serving live users on real-time market feeds.
Core product principle: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Explainability over complexity.

highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data. One workflow, zero copy-paste.

highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Early users acquired through Swiss-Indian community partnerships.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Founding manager for a new GTM Engineering function within Revenue Technology. Player/coach role: set technical direction for how AlphaSense uses automation and AI to accelerate revenue execution, while developing a team that partners with Sales, Marketing, and CS. Build durable automation patterns using AI agents, integration platforms (Zapier/Workato/BlinkOps), scripting (Python/JS), and Salesforce native tooling (Flow, Apex, APIs). Ship into real revenue workflows: routing, enrichment, Q2C, forecasting hygiene, outreach. 7+ years revenue ops / Salesforce dev / technical GTM. Remote (NA). $115k-$175k CAD.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit signals: LumApps production AI outbound agent (2x open/approved, $4M/quarter pipeline forecast), Beekeeper GenAI demo system pulling Salesforce data, AI Onboarding Specialist (CS workflow), $337K vendor cost takeout via LLM pipeline. 3 founded companies = founding-manager mindset. Gap: no deep Apex/Flow declarative Salesforce dev experience to call out in interviews. Salesforce integration experience is via consumption (pulling data, sales workflows), not native admin/dev. Remote role in NA, candidate is in Zurich - flag timezone in cover note.
